scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect Distrib property across projects in signing build
scenarios.reasoning: The agent answered the first half of the question correctly and worked efficiently, but reached the wrong conclusion on the central issue — it asserted no shared output directories when the shared ConfigurationLinterService path was the root cause. It even received a tool warning that 'not set' ≠ 'not shared' and did not investigate further, so the diagnostic explanation of the signing failure is misdirected.

rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder
Explained how the shared folder causes the signing conflict
